market_outlook.short_term: Cautiously constructive. US-China summit provides catalyst with low expectations. Diesel crisis and oil volatility create headline risk. Tech/AI momentum intact but vulnerable to sentiment shift. Copper/gold strength supports commodity-heavy portfolios. Dow's 3rd losing week suggests rotation into growth/tech. Monitor PMI data this week.
market_outlook.long_term: Structurally positive for energy transition, AI infrastructure, and commodity producers. Diesel shortage into 2027 supports energy capex. Trade diversification (Canada, India, Vietnam) creates new growth corridors. AI investment cycle likely continues but with increased volatility. Geopolitical fragmentation (dedollarization, Hormuz) elevates tail risk. Energy transition backlogs ($200B+ GEV) signal multi-year structural demand.
